description: Install Blockly, create all bot infrastructure files (bot-types.ts, bot-storage.ts, useBotRunner.ts), and create the RunPanel component. This is the foundational layer all other bot components depend on.
steps: Step 1: Install Blockly. Run from d:\tradebridge: `npm install blockly@10.4.3 --save --legacy-peer-deps`. Confirm package.json lists blockly@10.4.3 under dependencies.

Step 2: Create d:\tradebridge\src\components\bots\bot-types.ts. Must begin with no 'use client' (it is a pure types file). Define: BotStatus ('idle'|'connecting'|'running'|'cooldown'|'stopping'|'stopped'|'error'), StakeStrategy (union: {type:'fixed';amount:number} | {type:'martingale';base:number;multiplier:number;maxStake:number} | {type:'dalembert';unit:number;maxStake:number}), StopCondition (union: {type:'profit';target:number} | {type:'loss';limit:number} | {type:'tradeCount';max:number} | {type:'time';seconds:number}), BotConfig ({id:string;name:string;symbol:string;contractType:string;barrier?:string;duration:number;durationUnit:'t'|'s';stakeStrategy:StakeStrategy;stopConditions:StopCondition[];cooldownSeconds:number;maxTradesPerDay:number;maxConsecutiveLosses:number;createdAt:number;updatedAt:number}), BotRun ({botId:string;botName:string;startedAt:number;endedAt:number|null;status:BotStatus;tradeCount:number;wins:number;losses:number;netPnl:number;currency:string}), BotTransaction ({id:string;contractId:string;contractType:string;symbol:string;stake:number;payout:number|null;profit:number|null;currency:string;startedAt:number;settledAt:number|null;status:string}), JournalEntry ({timestamp:number;level:'info'|'warn'|'error';message:string}), BotRunState ({status:BotStatus;currentStake:number;tradeCount:number;wins:number;losses:number;netPnl:number;currency:string;transactions:BotTransaction[];journal:JournalEntry[];startedAt:number|null;lastError:string|null}).

Step 3: Create d:\tradebridge\src\components\bots\bot-storage.ts. Must begin with 'use client' (uses localStorage). Storage keys: CONFIGS_KEY='tradebridge:bots:configs', RUNS_KEY='tradebridge:bots:runs'. Exports: loadBotConfigs():BotConfig[], saveBotConfigs(configs:BotConfig[]):void, upsertBotConfig(config:BotConfig):void (load, replace-or-append, save), deleteBotConfig(id:string):void (load, filter, save), loadBotRuns():BotRun[], saveNewRun(run:BotRun):void (load, prepend, trim to 50, save). All JSON.parse calls wrapped in try/catch returning [] on error.

Step 4: Create d:\tradebridge\src\components\bots\useBotRunner.ts. Must begin with 'use client'. Import DerivAccount from '../trading/types' and BotConfig, BotRunState, BotTransaction, JournalEntry, BotStatus, StakeStrategy from './bot-types'. Import saveNewRun from './bot-storage'. Function signature: export function useBotRunner(connected:boolean, account:DerivAccount|null, config:BotConfig|null). Returns {runState:BotRunState; start:()=>void; stop:()=>void}. Implementation: (a) All state in useState (status, currentStake, tradeCount, wins, losses, netPnl, currency, transactions, journal, startedAt, lastError). Helper appendJournal(level,msg) updates journal state. (b) useEffect watches [connected, account?.account_id, account?.currency, config?.id] — tears down socket when any change. (c) start() fetches /api/auth/deriv/trade-session, opens WebSocket, sets status to 'connecting' then 'running' on open. (d) State machine: after each settled contract (proposal_open_contract with is_sold/is_expired), compute next stake via stake strategy, check all stop conditions, if any met call stopBot(), else set status 'cooldown' and setTimeout(config.cooldownSeconds*1000) then back to 'running' for next proposal. (e) Stake strategies: fixed=always config.stakeStrategy.amount; martingale=on loss multiply previous by multiplier capped at maxStake, on win reset to base; dalembert=on loss add unit capped at maxStake, on win subtract unit floored at (base for fixed/martingale reference: the 'base' or 'amount' field). (f) Pending marker localStorage key: 'tradebridge:bot-order-pending:'+account.account_id+':'+config.id — write 'pending' before send({buy:...}), clear on confirmed settlement. (g) stop() sets status 'stopping', waits for in-flight contract (if any), then closes socket and sets status 'stopped'. (h) On final stop, call saveNewRun with accumulated run summary.

Step 5: Create d:\tradebridge\src\components\bots\RunPanel.module.css. Define CSS classes for the panel: .runPanel (border, border-radius:14px, background:var(--panel), padding:0), .tabBar (display:flex, border-bottom:1px solid var(--line), padding:0 16px), .tab/.tabActive (min-height:40px, padding:0 14px, border:0, border-bottom:3px solid transparent / var(--teal), background:transparent, color:var(--muted)/var(--teal), font-size:11px font-weight:750), .tabContent (padding:16px), .statsGrid (display:grid, grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr), gap:10px), .statCard (padding:14px, border:1px solid var(--line), border-radius:10px, background:var(--surface)), .statLabel (color:var(--muted), font-size:10px, font-weight:700, margin-bottom:6px), .statValue (color:var(--ink), font-size:18px, font-weight:800, font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums), .runButton/.stopButton (width:100%, min-height:44px, margin-top:14px, border-radius:9px, font-size:12px, font-weight:800), .runButton (background:var(--teal), color:#0b1320, border:1px solid var(--teal)), .runButton:disabled (opacity:.5), .stopButton (background:var(--red), color:#fff, border:1px solid var(--red)), .txTable (width:100%, border-collapse:collapse, font-size:11px), .txTable th (color:var(--muted), font-weight:700, padding:6px 8px, text-align:left, border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)), .txTable td (padding:6px 8px, border-bottom:1px solid var(--line), color:var(--ink)), .journalList (list-style:none, margin:0, padding:0, display:grid, gap:4px, max-height:340px, overflow-y:auto), .journalItem (display:grid, grid-template-columns:auto 1fr, gap:8px, font-size:10px, line-height:1.5), .journalTime (color:var(--muted), white-space:nowrap, font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums), .journalInfo/.journalWarn/.journalError (color: var(--muted)/var(--amber)/var(--red)), .emptyState (padding:24px, text-align:center, color:var(--muted), font-size:11px).

Step 6: Create d:\tradebridge\src\components\bots\RunPanel.tsx. 'use client'. Import BotRunState, BotConfig, BotStatus from './bot-types'. Import styles from './RunPanel.module.css'. Props: {runState:BotRunState; onStart:()=>void; onStop:()=>void; config:BotConfig|null}. State: activeTab:'summary'|'transactions'|'journal'. Summary tab: 6 stat cards (Status, Trades, Wins, Losses, Win Rate as percentage, Net P&L); Run button when status is 'idle'|'stopped'|'error' and config is not null, Stop button when status is 'running'|'cooldown'|'connecting'|'stopping'. Transactions tab: table with columns Time/Symbol/Type/Stake/Payout/Profit/Status; empty state 'No transactions yet' when array is empty. Journal tab: ul list of journal entries newest-first; color by level. Format timestamps with new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString().
acceptance_criteria: npm install completes without error and blockly@10.4.3 appears in package.json dependencies
npx tsc --noEmit exits 0 with no errors after all 6 steps
bot-types.ts exports all 8 named types with correct shapes
useBotRunner.ts implements all 3 stake strategies and all 4 stop condition types
RunPanel.tsx renders all three tabs without runtime errors
verification: npx tsc --noEmit (from d:\tradebridge) exits 0 after all steps complete
findings: blockly@10.4.3 installed with --legacy-peer-deps (React 19 peer constraint). Package.json records it as ^10.4.3. Blockly is not directly imported in these foundation files (it will be used by BotBuilder in a later feature via next/dynamic+ssr:false). tsc --noEmit exits 0 with no warnings. useBotRunner uses a mutable stateRef pattern to avoid stale closures in WebSocket callbacks.
